name: Herm's Inn (Logan, UT) "Herm's Hash" Crispy Corned Beef Hash & Two Eggs
whyItWorks: Scratch-made juniper-cured corned beef griddled with shredded potatoes and served with two eggs cooked to order. Flavorful and hearty.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Herm's Hash with scrambled or poached eggs and white toast (hold raw onions if sensitive).
watchOuts: Corned beef has sodium and spices; moderate portion advised
